name: buggrbox
description: Gives Claude physical access to embedded prototypes through a BuggrBox: DUT power and current, GPIO, UART, I2C, SWD debug and recovery. Includes the MCP server and a setup skill.

serial.title: Box serial number (only with several boxes)
serial.description: Leave empty with one BuggrBox. With several, the MAC address of the one to use, e.g. AA:BB:CC:11:22:33 (adapter_status and device_info show it).
